messages:
Rena: Quick sync on NimbusAI case study + webinar. Need: interview permissions, quote approvals, demo slot, consent on reg form, and SFDC lead routing to the nimbus-ae queue. Brief: https://redwood.docs/nimbus-case
Omar: I'll book interviews. Suggested spokes: CTO (infra impact) + Head of Product (business outcomes). Demo 5 mins mid-show.
Liz: Draft pull quote: "NimbusAI saw major inference cost and latency wins after moving to Redwood". Flagging percent claims with [LEGAL].
Cal: Legal prefers conservative wording unless Nimbus provides signed confirmation of numbers. If they request transcript redactions or an NDA, expect +48-72h. Tag any precise stats with [LEGAL].
Liz: Sent pull quote and promo script to Nimbus for redline. Also added GDPR-friendly consent copy on reg form: "I consent to Redwood contacting me and to the webinar recording being used for marketing; data processed per privacy policy."
ops-bot: Registration updated: consent checkbox added, hidden field consent=true for routing. Webhook mapped to SFDC campaign Nimbus-Q3, routing rule: if(form.request_demo==true) owner_queue=nimbus-ae else owner_queue=nimbus-sdr. Test passed in staging.
Rena: Great. Target embargo Sept 30. Legal signoff needed by Sept 23. If Nimbus sends a confirmation email with a percent stat we can include it; otherwise we use conservative wording.
Omar: Doodle out with Tue/Wed/Thu slots. Asked Nimbus for permission to record and for written percent confirmation if available.
Liz: Will prepare 30s/60s promo cutdowns and mark verbatim quotes with [LEGAL] tags so we can swap if redactions occur.
Rena: TL;DR: interviews scheduling, legal looped, reg consent done, SFDC mapping to nimbus-ae/nimbus-sdr, embargo Sept 30. Check-in tomorrow AM. :rocket:
